meta.title: 分析PWA状态切换体验问题
meta.body_summary: Refactor PWA state management to initialize state before Vue app mounts, add loading state manager, and enhance Service Worker caching to eliminate loading screens and flickering during background-to-foreground transitions.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor-authored PWA state restoration merged immediately by repository owner without review; only narrative improvement claims with no benchmarks or reproduction steps.

The core implementation changes are concentrated in Vue components and utility files. The PR was merged quickly by the author without review, consistent with a self-contained optimization.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored PWA state restoration in a Vue.js frontend: added loadingStateManager.ts, modified pwaStateManager.ts to initialize state before app mount, updated App.vue to remove loading indicators and flickering, enhanced service-worker.ts with caching and navigation preloading, and adjusted vite.config.ts for PWA settings. Multiple markdown analysis reports were added then removed.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Three markdown reports were added for analysis then removed in final commits; vite.config.ts adjustments support PWA configuration; usePWAState.ts had minor log removals.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Added PWA_Performance_Analysis.md with detailed analysis.
Second commit: Implemented core optimization (App.vue, main.ts, new loadingStateManager, pwaStateManager modifications, service-worker updates) and added PWA_Optimization_Summary.md.
Third commit: Silent optimization summary added, further refined App.vue and pwaStateManager to remove UI indicators.
Fourth commit: Removed all markdown analysis reports and console logs from source files.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor made 4 commits over a short period; PR was merged by author (jxxghp) within 4 minutes with no review or comment activity.
